verdict.rationale: OpenClaw's memory is plain Markdown files in the agent's workspace, and the model only remembers what is saved to disk. The agent can also run shell commands over workspace files and borrow external tools via MCP. Together these suggest a user could place notes in the workspace or connect a knowledge source, but nothing documents a dedicated document knowledge base or grounded Q&A over it. Missing for 10: a documented way to attach your own documents, indexing or retrieval (RAG) over a user corpus, grounded or cited answers, and any hands-on or independent corroboration.
